logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was determined experimentally using the “shake flask” method. Nanopure water was used as the aqueous phase and 1-octanol was used as the organic phase. A 100 μM solution of the complex was prepared in 1-octanol and then mixed with and equal volume of water. The solution was shaken vigorously for 5 min and allowed to settle for 24 h while protected from light. The relative concentrations in the water and 1-octanol layers were determined spectrophometrically using a Cary 60 UV–Vis spectrophotometer. LogP was calculated using the absorbance in 1-octanol over the absorbance in water at the lambda max for each compound as follows: Ru-1a 455 nm; Ru-2a 460 nm; Ru-3a 465 nm; Ru-1b 475 nm; Ru-2b 470 nm; Ru-1c 370 nm; Ru-3c 470 nm.
